mechanism: Inbound: donor asks prior DAF provider to grant to Fidelity Charitable (EIN 11-0303001) with Giving Account number in designation. Outbound: grant recommendation to eligible 501(c)(3) subject to review
minimums: No minimum to open; minimum grant $50
fees: Admin 0.60% or $100 min on first $500k, tiered lower; no transfer fee published
stated_timeline: Approved grants typically made within 10 business days; more if new charity due diligence
notes: No explicit outbound DAF-to-DAF policy found.

mechanism: Inbound: open account, then recommend grant from current provider naming DAFgiving360 account name and number in memo
notes: Page returned HTTP 403 to fetch; content from search summary. Largest outbound DAF-to-DAF grantor named by IPS (>$0.5B in 2024 to NPT, RCF, Fidelity).

mechanism: Grants to 501(c)(3) public charities in good standing; inbound grants from other DAFs accepted (not deductible)
in_kind_or_cash: Contributed assets liquidated at sponsor's sole discretion
minimums: Min initial contribution $25,000; min grant $500, but an account with balance under $500 may make one final closing grant below $500; one $500 grant every 3 years
fees: $250 annual maintenance fee may apply below $25,000 balance
notes: Policies updated 2026-01-09. Closing-grant minimum exception is the only closure-related term found.

mechanism: Grant recommendation; no transfer page found
fees: No grant fees; admin fee blended schedule on average daily balance
notes: Abandoned accounts without successors go to NPT Giving Fund.

mechanism: Inbound: in-app 'Donor-advised fund transfer' via Chariot DAFpay, or grant from prior provider to Daffy (EIN 86-3177440), non-anonymous
stated_timeline: Up to several weeks depending on sending DAF
history_portability: Closing: tax summary and receipts no longer accessible after account closed; donors told to download first
notes: Closure requires $0 balance via donations to charities; outbound DAF-to-DAF not addressed.

sponsor: Charityvest Inc (also sponsor for Foundation Source turnkey programs)
mechanism: Inbound: grant from existing DAF to Charityvest Inc (EIN 81-2771871) with account email in notes; ACH details on request
minimums: $0 to open; $15 minimum contribution and grant
stated_timeline: Credited as soon as grant received
notes: Transfers marked non-deductible automatically. Prior fee-waiver transfer promo (ran to 2023).

mechanism: Inbound: closing grant recommendation from former sponsor to new AEF DAF
in_kind_or_cash: AEF accepts broad assets (private stock, real estate, crypto) for contributions; transfer form not stated
history_portability: Platform migration (Ren) kept only prior two years of history in new portal
notes: Requires financial advisor to manage assets; states 'nearly all other DAF sponsors allow these transfers'; ~$200M transferred in over several years.

sponsor: Renaissance Charitable Foundation (RCF/Ren; incl. Edward Jones and other branded programs)
mechanism: Inbound: after application and investment account open, submit Account Closing Grant request to existing provider payable to RCF with fund name and investment account number
in_kind_or_cash: Investment account at advisor's custodian with RCF as owner
minimums: Program-specific minimum initial balance (amount not stated on page)
stated_timeline: Funds post 2-5 days after proof of funding (general funding step)
notes: Adviser relationship travels in if receiving program allows the adviser. Partner-specific terms differ (see repo Edward Jones/NWM notes).

mechanism: Inbound: grant from external DAF to GiveClear for credit to TIFIN Give Giving Fund; outbound grants to public charities and private operating foundations
in_kind_or_cash: Securities transfers accepted but 'can be a lengthy process'
minimums: No minimum contribution or balance; minimum grant $100
fees: Admin 0.60% to $1M, 0.20% above; adviser fee set by adviser <=1%
stated_timeline: Grant review within 48 hours; electronic 2-7 business days; checks within 5 business days
notes: Guidelines dated 2025-08-12. No succession: grants to last 3 grantees.
Sitemap search found no transfer/policy page.

sponsor: Greater Tacoma Community Foundation (community foundation example)
mechanism: Inbound: open GTCF DAF; recommend 'DAF-to-DAF Transfer Grant' from current sponsor; full balance or installments
in_kind_or_cash: Generally cash; current sponsor typically liquidates securities before granting
minimums: Notes some sponsors require minimum balance to keep account open
stated_timeline: Grant recs typically 5-10 business days at sending sponsor; whole process 2-4 weeks; credit 3-5 business days after receipt
history_portability: Donor should download full grant history, contribution records, acknowledgments before closing prior DAF
notes: Document updated 2026-05-18. Transfer not deductible; GTCF cannot initiate closure at other sponsor.

in_kind_or_cash: Cash held in dedicated bank account; not invested
minimums: At least 5% of each account recommended annually
notes: Policy updated 2024-08-13. Inactive after 36 months; funds may go to charities PGF selects. Included for processor contrast.
